mapper.select: SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date < CURDATE()

SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date = CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date > CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ws.expiry_date <= CURDATE() + INTERVAL 3 DAY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (category, title, message, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES ('INVENTORY', #{title}, #{message}, 'HQ', #{targetId}, NOW())
